fn link_pin_spec() -> crate::os_dsl::RecordSpec {
    crate::os_dsl::RecordSpec::new(
        None,
        crate::os_dsl::RecordLayout::Inline,
        vec![
            crate::os_dsl::FieldSpec::new(0, "kind", crate::os_dsl::Shape::Enum(vec![("head".to_string(), 0), ("checkpoint".to_string(), 1), ("snapshot".to_string(), 2)])),
            crate::os_dsl::FieldSpec::new(1, "checkpoint_id", crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text).optional(),
            crate::os_dsl::FieldSpec::new(2, "blob_hash", crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text).optional(),
            crate::os_dsl::FieldSpec::new(3, "blob_size", crate::os_dsl::Shape::UInt).optional(),
            crate::os_dsl::FieldSpec::new(4, "blob_media_type", crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text).optional(),
        ],
    )
}

fn link_pin_spec_controlled<C:crate::os_dsl::NativeSchemaControl>(control:&mut C)->Result<crate::os_dsl::RecordSpec,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
    control.scoped_stage(|control|{control.begin_stage(5)?;let mut fields=control.allocate_vec(5)?;let mut labels=control.allocate_vec(3)?;
        for(key,id)in[("head",0),("checkpoint",1),("snapshot",2)]{labels.push((control.copy_text(key)?,id));}
        fields.push(crate::os_dsl::schema::producer::field(0,"kind",crate::os_dsl::Shape::Enum(labels),control)?);control.step()?;
        for(id,key,shape)in[(1,"checkpoint_id",crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text),(2,"blob_hash",crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text),(3,"blob_size",crate::os_dsl::Shape::UInt),(4,"blob_media_type",crate::os_dsl::Shape::Text)]{fields.push(crate::os_dsl::schema::producer::field(id,key,shape,control)?.optional());control.step()?;}
        crate::os_dsl::schema::producer::record(None,crate::os_dsl::RecordLayout::Inline,fields,control)
    })
}
fn link_pin_spec_producer()->crate::os_dsl::RecordSpecProducer{crate::os_dsl::RecordSpecProducer{ordinary:link_pin_spec,decoding:|control|link_pin_spec_controlled(control),encoding:|control|link_pin_spec_controlled(control)}}

fn link_pin_to_record(pin: &LinkPin) -> crate::os_dsl::RecordValue {
    let mut record = crate::os_dsl::RecordValue::default();
    match pin {
        LinkPin::Head => {
            record.fields.insert(0, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Enum(0));
        }
        LinkPin::Checkpoint { id } => {
            record.fields.insert(0, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Enum(1));
            record.fields.insert(1, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(id.clone()));
        }
        LinkPin::Snapshot { blob } => {
            record.fields.insert(0, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Enum(2));
            record.fields.insert(2, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(blob.hash.clone()));
            record.fields.insert(3, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::UInt(blob.size));
            record.fields.insert(4, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(blob.media_type.clone()));
        }
    }
    record
}

fn link_pin_to_record_controlled(pin:&LinkPin,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
    use crate::os_dsl::{FieldValue as V,native_encoding::EncodedRecord};
    control.scoped_depth(64,|control|control.scoped_stage(|control|{
        let count=match pin{LinkPin::Head=>1,LinkPin::Checkpoint{..}=>2,LinkPin::Snapshot{..}=>4};control.begin_stage(count)?;let mut output=EncodedRecord::new(count,control)?;
        let ordinal=match pin{LinkPin::Head=>0,LinkPin::Checkpoint{..}=>1,LinkPin::Snapshot{..}=>2};output.insert(0,V::Enum(ordinal))?;control.step()?;
        match pin{LinkPin::Head=>{},LinkPin::Checkpoint{id}=>{output.insert(1,V::Text(control.copy_text(id)?))?;control.step()?;},LinkPin::Snapshot{blob}=>{output.insert(2,V::Text(control.copy_text(&blob.hash)?))?;control.step()?;output.insert(3,V::UInt(blob.size))?;control.step()?;output.insert(4,V::Text(control.copy_text(&blob.media_type)?))?;control.step()?;}}
        Ok(output.take())
    }))
}

fn validate_link_pin_record(record:&crate::os_dsl::RecordValue)->Result<u32,String>{
    let Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Enum(ordinal))=record.get(0)else{return Err("expected link pin kind Enum".into());};
    let fields:&[u16]=match ordinal{0=>&[0],1=>&[0,1],2=>&[0,2,3,4],_=>return Err("unknown link pin kind ordinal".into())};
    if record.fields.keys().any(|id|*id>4)||fields.iter().any(|id|matches!(record.get(*id),None|Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Absent)))||record.fields.iter().any(|(id,value)|!matches!(value,crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Absent)&&!fields.contains(id)){return Err("link pin fields differ from its declared branch".into());}
    Ok(*ordinal)
}
fn link_pin_from_record_controlled(record:&crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<LinkPin,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
    control.scoped_stage(|control|{
        control.checkpoint()?;let ordinal=validate_link_pin_record(record).map_err(|message|semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,message))?;control.begin_stage(match ordinal{0=>1,1=>2,2=>4,_=>unreachable!()})?;control.step()?;
        let text=|id|match record.get(id){Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(value))=>Ok(value.as_str()),_=>Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"link pin field must be Text"))};
        match ordinal{
            0=>Ok(LinkPin::Head),
            1=>{let id=control.copy_text(text(1)?)?;control.step()?;Ok(LinkPin::Checkpoint{id})},
            2=>{let hash=text(2)?;let media_type=text(4)?;let Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::UInt(size))=record.get(3)else{return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"link pin blob size must be UInt"));};let hash=control.copy_text(hash)?;control.step()?;let size=*size;control.step()?;let media_type=control.copy_text(media_type)?;control.step()?;Ok(LinkPin::Snapshot{blob:BlobRef{hash,size,media_type}})},
            _=>unreachable!(),
        }
    })
}

fn link_pin_from_record(record: &crate::os_dsl::RecordValue) -> Result<LinkPin, String> {
    validate_link_pin_record(record)?;
    let ordinal = match record.get(0) {
        Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Enum(n)) => *n,
        other => return Err(format!("expected kind, found {other:?}")),
    };
    match ordinal {
        0 => Ok(LinkPin::Head),
        1 => {
            let id = match record.get(1) {
                Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(s)) => s.clone(),
                other => return Err(format!("expected checkpoint_id, found {other:?}")),
            };
            Ok(LinkPin::Checkpoint { id })
        }
        2 => {
            let hash = match record.get(2) {
                Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(s)) => s.clone(),
                other => return Err(format!("expected blob_hash, found {other:?}")),
            };
            let size = match record.get(3) {
                Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::UInt(n)) => *n,
                other => return Err(format!("expected blob_size, found {other:?}")),
            };
            let media_type = match record.get(4) {
                Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(s)) => s.clone(),
                other => return Err(format!("expected blob_media_type, found {other:?}")),
            };
            Ok(LinkPin::Snapshot { blob: BlobRef { hash, size, media_type } })
        }
        other => Err(format!("unknown link pin kind ordinal {other}")),
    }
}

impl crate::os_dsl::DslField for LinkPin {
    /// 🚫️async: E4 — see `DslField::shape`'s tag on the trait.
    fn shape() -> crate::os_dsl::Shape {
        crate::os_dsl::Shape::Record(link_pin_spec_producer())
    }
    fn shape_controlled<C:crate::os_dsl::NativeSchemaControl>(control:&mut C)->Result<crate::os_dsl::Shape,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{control.checkpoint()?;Ok(crate::os_dsl::Shape::Record(link_pin_spec_producer()))}

    fn to_record_controlled(&self,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{link_pin_to_record_controlled(self,control)}
    fn from_value(value: &crate::os_dsl::FieldValue) -> Result<Self, String> {
        match value {
            crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(record) => link_pin_from_record(record),
            other => Err(format!("expected Record, found {other:?}")),
        }
    }
    fn from_value_controlled(value:&crate::os_dsl::FieldValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<Self,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{let crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(record)=value else{return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"expected link pin Record"));};link_pin_from_record_controlled(record,control)}
    fn from_record_controlled(record:&crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<Self,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{link_pin_from_record_controlled(record,control)}

fn artifact_link_to_record(link: &ArtifactLink) -> crate::os_dsl::RecordValue {
    let mut record = crate::os_dsl::RecordValue::default();
    record.fields.insert(0, <crate::os_io::ArtifactRef as crate::os_dsl::DslField>::to_value(&link.target));
    record.fields.insert(1, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(link_pin_to_record(&link.pin)));
    record.fields.insert(2, crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(link.role.clone()));

fn artifact_link_to_record_controlled(link:&ArtifactLink,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{

        output.insert(1,V::Record(link_pin_to_record_controlled(&link.pin,control)?))?;control.step()?;
        output.insert(2,V::Text(control.copy_text(&link.role)?))?;control.step()?;
        Ok(output.take())
    }))
}

fn artifact_link_from_record(record: &crate::os_dsl::RecordValue) -> Result<ArtifactLink, String> {
    if record.fields.len()!=3||record.fields.keys().any(|id|*id>2){return Err("artifact link requires its three declared fields".into());}
    let target=<crate::os_io::ArtifactRef as crate::os_dsl::DslField>::from_value(record.get(0).ok_or("artifact link requires target")?)?;
    let pin = match record.get(1) {
        Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(record)) => link_pin_from_record(record)?,
        other => return Err(format!("expected pin, found {other:?}")),
    };
    let role = match record.get(2) {
        Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(s)) => s.clone(),
        other => return Err(format!("expected role, found {other:?}")),
    };
    Ok(ArtifactLink { target, pin, role })
}

fn artifact_link_from_record_controlled(record:&crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<ArtifactLink,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{
    control.scoped_stage(|control|{
        control.begin_stage(3)?;if record.fields.len()!=3||record.fields.keys().any(|id|*id>2){return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"artifact link requires its three declared fields"));}
        let target=record.get(0).ok_or_else(||semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"artifact link requires target"))?;
        let Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(pin))=record.get(1)else{return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"artifact link pin must be Record"));};
        let Some(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Text(role))=record.get(2)else{return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"artifact link role must be Text"));};
        validate_link_pin_record(pin).map_err(|message|semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,message))?;
        let target=<crate::os_io::ArtifactRef as crate::os_dsl::DslField>::from_value_controlled(target,control)?;control.step()?;
        let pin=link_pin_from_record_controlled(pin,control)?;control.step()?;let role=control.copy_text(role)?;control.step()?;
        Ok(ArtifactLink{target,pin,role})
    })
}

impl crate::os_dsl::DslField for ArtifactLink {
    /// 🚫️async: E4 — see `DslField::shape`'s tag on the trait.
    fn shape() -> crate::os_dsl::Shape {
        crate::os_dsl::Shape::Record(artifact_link_spec_producer())
    }
    fn shape_controlled<C:crate::os_dsl::NativeSchemaControl>(control:&mut C)->Result<crate::os_dsl::Shape,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{control.checkpoint()?;Ok(crate::os_dsl::Shape::Record(artifact_link_spec_producer()))}
    fn to_value(&self) -> crate::os_dsl::FieldValue {
        crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(artifact_link_to_record(self))
    }
    fn to_value_controlled(&self,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<crate::os_dsl::FieldValue,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{artifact_link_to_record_controlled(self,control).map(crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record)}
    fn to_record_controlled(&self,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeEncodeControl<'_>)->Result<crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{artifact_link_to_record_controlled(self,control)}
    fn from_value(value: &crate::os_dsl::FieldValue) -> Result<Self, String> {
        match value {
            crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(record) => artifact_link_from_record(record),
            other => Err(format!("expected Record, found {other:?}")),
        }
    }
    fn from_value_controlled(value:&crate::os_dsl::FieldValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<Self,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{let crate::os_dsl::FieldValue::Record(record)=value else{return Err(semio_framework_value::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,"expected artifact link Record"));};artifact_link_from_record_controlled(record,control)}
    fn from_record_controlled(record:&crate::os_dsl::RecordValue,control:&mut crate::os_dsl::NativeDecodeControl<'_>)->Result<Self,semio_framework_value::ValueError>{artifact_link_from_record_controlled(record,control)}

}

//#region 🔖️Authority
/// 🧾 Receipt from the sole store write gate (`dispatch` / `reset`). `messages`/`worst` carry
/// whatever `crate::os_spr::MutationMessage`s the command's own replay produced (empty/`None` for a
/// structural command with nothing to report) — `26/08/16/MUTATION-OUTCOMES-MERGE-POLICIES-AND-
/// FIRST-CLASS-CONFLICTS` §C6. `Eq` dropped (was `#[derive(.., PartialEq, Eq)]`): `EditMessages`
/// only derives `PartialEq`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct CommandReceipt {
    pub edit_ids: Vec<String>,
    pub generation: u64,
    pub messages: Vec<crate::os_spr::EditMessages>,
    pub worst: Option<semio_framework_diagnostic::Severity>,
}

//#region 🔮️Projection
//#region 🧭️Stamps
/// 🧬️ History identity for a projection input, independent of the process-local generation.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct ArtifactRevision {
    pub artifact_id: String,
    pub schema: String,
    pub applied_edit_ids: crate::os_vcs::HistoryPageStack<String>,
    pub redo_edit_ids: crate::os_vcs::HistoryPageStack<String>,
    pub checkpoint_id: Option<String>,
}

/// 🎯️ Exact state identity a projection or inference result must match before it is accepted.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct ArtifactProjectionStamp {
    pub revision: ArtifactRevision,
    pub generation: u64,
}

/// 🔄️ Store transition that produced a projection input.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum ArtifactProjectionCause {
    Apply,
    RemoteIngest,
    Replay,
    Undo,
    Redo,
    Reset,
    Checkout,
    PolicyChange,
    ExternalResourceChange,
    Checkpoint,
    PruneDrafts,
}

/// 🗄️ Explicit prior-result handling; projections never infer cache authority from state alone.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum ArtifactProjectionCacheMode {
    Rebuild,
    ReusePrevious,
    ValidatePrevious,
}
//#endregion 🧭️Stamps

//#region 📡️Events
/// 📬️ Typed projection/inference input carrying the exact artifact version it observed.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArtifactProjectionEvent<State, Previous, Policy> {
    pub stamp: ArtifactProjectionStamp,
    pub cause: ArtifactProjectionCause,
    pub state: State,
    pub previous: Option<Previous>,
    pub cache_mode: ArtifactProjectionCacheMode,
    pub policy: Policy,
}

/// 🧩️ Projection output plus an optional semantic-diff candidate. This layer validates freshness;
/// strict `ArtifactDiff` application stays owned by the semantic-mutation boundary.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArtifactProjectionResult<Output, Diff = ()> {
    pub stamp: ArtifactProjectionStamp,
    pub output: Output,
    pub proposed_diff: Option<Diff>,
}

impl<State, Previous, Policy> ArtifactProjectionEvent<State, Previous, Policy> {
    /// 🧪️ Couples an asynchronously computed result to this event's immutable stamp.
    pub async fn result<Output, Diff>(&self, output: Output, proposed_diff: Option<Diff>) -> ArtifactProjectionResult<Output, Diff> {
        ArtifactProjectionResult { stamp: self.stamp.clone(), output, proposed_diff }
    }
}

/// ✅️ A current projection result, intentionally separated from semantic-diff application.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct AcceptedArtifactProjection<Output, Diff = ()> {
    pub output: Output,
    pub proposed_diff: Option<Diff>,
}

/// 🚫️ A result computed against an older state and therefore forbidden from changing current state.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct StaleArtifactProjection {
    pub computed_for: ArtifactProjectionStamp,
    pub current: ArtifactProjectionStamp,
}

/// 📣️ One state or dependency transition that invalidates derived artifact work.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ArtifactProjectionInvalidation {
    pub cause: ArtifactProjectionCause,
    pub stamp: ArtifactProjectionStamp,
}
//#endregion 📡️Events
//#endregion 🔮️Projection

/// 👁️ Read-only view over a document envelope — mutation is sealed through `dispatch`/`reset`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct ArtifactEnvelopeView<'a, P, Mutation> {
    envelope: &'a ArtifactEnvelope<P, Mutation>,
}

impl<'a, P, Mutation> ArtifactEnvelopeView<'a, P, Mutation> {
    pub async fn schema(&self) -> &str {
        &self.envelope.schema
    }
    pub async fn id(&self) -> &str {
        &self.envelope.id
    }
    pub async fn vcs(&self) -> &ArtifactVcs<P, Mutation> {
        &self.envelope.vcs
    }
    pub async fn backbone(&self) -> Option<&ArtifactBackboneRef> {
        self.envelope.backbone.as_ref()
    }
    pub async fn active_alternative_id(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        self.envelope.active_alternative_id.as_deref()
    }

        self.envelope.cursor.as_ref()
    }
    pub async fn edit_messages(&self) -> &ArtifactEditMessageLedger {
        &self.envelope.edit_messages
    }
    pub async fn conflicts(&self) -> &[crate::os_spr::Conflict] {

    }

    }
